$comment: Dwell's skinned models (docs/CHARACTERS.md §11, ADR 0070). Each model is a GLB in shared/models/glb (the checked-in source of truth, made once by `node shared/models/import.mjs --from <unpacked packs>` from its pack's FBX with the palette remap below), its scale, its yaw (degrees turning its front to +z), and which of its clips play each role. A role a model has no entry for plays its `fallback`. `speed` scales a clip's playback. `hand` (optional) names the skin joint a held item follows and the turn and offset (metres, in the joint's frame) from that joint to the characters rig's hand bone, the frame the held items in shared/characters are authored in. `source` records where the GLB came from (the pack and the paths inside it); `remap` turns a source colour (sRGB hex) into a palette stop before the nearest-stop snap. Run `node shared/models/gen.mjs` after editing.

palette.$comment: Palette ramps a remap never snaps to: utility and effect colours.

detail.$comment: Model detail (ADR 0070 §10; no Settings control since 0.52.5, owner 2026-11-10: "remove the slider and make 60% the default"; `?modeldetail=<id>` overrides it): the import bakes every skinned model at each level, decimated (Blender Decimate, collapse) to `ratio` of its faces and shaded flat, as GLB meshes detail_0, detail_1, … on the one skin; the level is one for every skinned model, changed live by `setModelDetail`. The first level is the full mesh (ratio 1). `default` is the level every player draws (60 %, the owner's pick, 2026-11-10). Re-import (shared/models/import.mjs) after changing a ratio.

firstPerson.$comment: Your first-person arms drawn from this model (docs/CHARACTERS.md §5, §11.10): the triangles whose three vertices each have at least `weight` of their skin weight on `joints` (the right arm from the shoulder down: the cut at the shoulder), skinned by the retarget map from the first-person arms' clips (characters.json `firstPerson`), the arm's shoulder put on the rig's arm bone and the arm scaled so its rest reach (shoulder to hand) is the rig's. `turn` (degrees, Euler XYZ in view space: +x left, +y up, +z ahead) turns the whole arm about its hand after, so the hand and the item stay where the clips put them while the elbow and the sleeve's cuff come up into the bottom-right of the view. Needs `retarget`.

grips.$comment: How the hand closes on what it holds (docs/CHARACTERS.md §11.10): `poses` turn skin joints (degrees, Euler XYZ, on top of each joint's own turn: the fingers bend about their z), `items` names the pose each held item (shared/characters/characters.json `items`) takes; an item not listed is held in the open hand (a block or a torch on the palm). Fitted so the curled fingertips close round the handle's line (props.json `hand`, a test in render/skinned.rs).

retarget.$comment: Drives the Peasant from the characters rig's pose (docs/CHARACTERS.md §11.9, ADR 0070 amendment 2026-11-10): each rig bone names the skin joint it turns, and `rest` (degrees, Euler XYZ in the model's space) turns that joint's rest frame onto the bone's rest (the Peasant stands in an A pose, the rig with its arms and legs straight down). Joints no bone names keep their rest turn under their parent. `root` is the rig bone whose joint takes the clips' root offset (scaled by the two hip heights). Without a rig pose the model plays its own clips (`roles`).

poses.$comment: Idle poses as joint turns on the idle clip (WORK_QUEUE item 39; degrees, Euler XYZ in each joint's frame). Seen in game with `__dwell.animalPose` (2026-11-12): +x on the neck joints raises the head, so graze is negative and lookUp positive.

remove.$comment: The doe is the deer without its antlers: the loose parts weighted wholly to the skull that reach above the ears (model units, up).

poses.$comment: Idle poses as joint turns on the idle clip (WORK_QUEUE item 39; degrees, Euler XYZ in each joint's frame). Seen in game with `__dwell.animalPose` (2026-11-12): +x on the neck joints raises the head, so graze is negative and lookUp positive.

wolf.$comment: The wolf is the dog recoloured and 1.5 times its size (owner, 2026-11-10: "use the dog recolored. Make it twice as big", then "The wolf should be shrunk about 75% of its size": 75 % of 2): the dog's FBX with the pack's colours remapped to the wolf ramps (the eyes and nose stay black), then painted by its `coat` (shared/models/coat.mjs), which also covers the dog's blue collar and red tongue with fur. The collar is part of the dog's one mesh, not a loose part a `remove` could drop.

coat.$comment: A grey wolf's coat, blended (owner, 2026-11-10: the per-face colours read as Balto, "very harsh color changes"; a wolf is "more the blend"): fawn flanks, a dark grizzled saddle and grey shoulders, a cream belly, legs and throat, a pale muzzle, a grey tail with a dark tip. The eyes and the nose keep their black. Coordinates: along 0 the nose → 1 the tail's tip, height 0 the feet → 1 the ears' tips (the back is about 0.7).
